channel.desc: Thriller 2019 After his wife's death, Frank takes a trip to Ireland to scatter her ashes, reluctantly joined by his estranged son Sean. As long-buried secrets and a chance encounter unravel the past, father and son confront their grief and each other. John Hawkes, Logan Lerman, Sarah Bolger, Andrea Irvine, Elfar Adalsteins, Michael Armbruster.
